Ads - Master switches.description: Kill switches. ads_enabled=false hides every ad in the app within seconds (real-time update).

ads_enabled.description: Master switch for ALL ads (interstitial + native). false = ad-free app.

interstitial_ads_enabled.description: Switch for all full-screen interstitials (app launch, get started, on download).

native_ads_enabled.description: Switch for all native ad cards (splash, onboarding, language, home, downloads).

use_test_ads.description: Force Google sample ad units even in release builds (QA / Play review). Debug builds always use test ads regardless.

Ads - Placements.description: Per-placement on/off. Only matters while the master switches above are true.

ad_splash_native_enabled.description: Placement 1 - native ad pinned to the bottom of the splash screen.

ad_app_launch_interstitial_enabled.description: Placement 2 - interstitial shown when the splash finishes.

ad_onboarding_native_enabled.description: Placement 3 - full-screen sponsored page inside onboarding (page is removed when false).

ad_language_native_enabled.description: Placement 5 - large native card inside the language list.

ad_home_native_enabled.description: Placement 6 - large native card on the home screen.

ad_downloads_native_enabled.description: Placement 7 - medium native card at the top of the downloads list.

ad_on_download_interstitial_enabled.description: Placement 8 - interstitial before a download starts / retries.

Ads - AdMob ad unit IDs.description: Replace the Google sample IDs with your own ad units from the AdMob console (Apps > Ad units). Format: ca-app-pub-XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX/YYYYYYYYYY. The AdMob APP id lives in the manifest (ADMOB_APP_ID in local.properties), not here.

admob_interstitial_app_launch_id.description: Interstitial ad unit - app launch placement.

admob_interstitial_get_started_id.description: Interstitial ad unit - get started placement.

admob_interstitial_on_download_id.description: Interstitial ad unit - on download placement.

admob_native_splash_id.description: Native Advanced ad unit - splash screen.

admob_native_onboarding_id.description: Native Advanced ad unit - onboarding full-screen page.

admob_native_language_id.description: Native Advanced ad unit - language screen.

admob_native_home_id.description: Native Advanced ad unit - home screen.

admob_native_downloads_id.description: Native Advanced ad unit - downloads screen.

interstitial_min_interval_sec.description: Minimum seconds between two interstitials (frequency cap). 0 disables the cap.

interstitial_load_timeout_ms.description: Max time the 'Loading ad...' dialog may block before the flow continues without an ad (1000-15000).

splash_ad_display_ms.description: How long the splash stays visible once its native ad has loaded.

splash_no_ad_delay_ms.description: Splash duration when the splash ad is disabled or fails to load.

splash_timeout_ms.description: Hard upper bound for the splash screen (offline / ad hang).

onboarding_ad_countdown_sec.description: Seconds the onboarding sponsored page is locked before 'Next' becomes enabled (0-30).

pro_screen_enabled.description: Shows the Pro / Premium screen from the sidebar 'Go Premium' button.

push_topics.description: Comma-separated FCM topics every install subscribes to. The app also subscribes to lang_<code> automatically.

version.description: Initial template: ad switches, ad unit ids, timings, feature flags
